entities.summary: Mikhail Dauhaliavets is a Belarusian boxer. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, he competed in the Men's light heavyweight, but was defeated in the first round by Oleksandr Hvozdyk. He also competed in the same weight division at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He beat Valentino Manfredonia before losing to eventual silver medalist Adilbek Niyazymbetov.
